descriptions.w3d_d24h_aim_start_800a8b38: Airstrike AI start: reads AIStrike.TargetPoint, AIStrike.Direction and AIStrike.SeekTarget. When seeking, sets speed +76 to pi / 2, the goal +96 to the target point, the up vector +28 to (0, 1, 0) and the yaw +80 from the direction (0x802e7e5c), runs 0x800a93fc, and when the squared distance from +16 to the target is below 10 writes Airstrike.TargetPoint, Payload.Target, Airstrike.Direction, Airstrike.HasTarget = 1, Airstrike.WaterTarget = 0 and AIStrike.SeekTarget = 0, then posts a 12-byte message of kind 13.
